articles.title: Arsenal Dominate Man City 3-0 in Community Shield Statement Win
articles.summary: Arsenal crushed Manchester City 3-0 in the Community Shield, with Riccardo Calafiori scoring after just 24 seconds. New City boss Enzo Maresca's debut was a disaster.

articles.title: Tropical Storm Lala Batters Hawaii with Torrential Rain and Power Outages
articles.summary: Tropical Storm Lala is hammering Hawaii with up to 35 inches of rain and hurricane-force gusts. Over 130,000 households lost power, and at least one person has died.

articles.title: Daring Heist: Thieves Steal Four Antonello da Messina Masterpieces from Sicilian Museum
articles.summary: Thieves stole four Renaissance paintings by Antonello da Messina worth up to $92 million from a museum in Messina, Sicily. The heist happened during Ferragosto celebrations.
